scripts.dev:reset: docker compose down -v && NODE_VERSION=$(cat .nvmrc) docker compose up -d --build
scripts.test:e2e:headless: NODE_VERSION=$(cat .nvmrc) docker compose --env-file .env.test -f compose.test.yaml up --exit-code-from cypress
scripts.test:e2e:critical: NODE_VERSION=$(cat .nvmrc) CYPRESS_SPEC="cypress/e2e/critical" docker compose --env-file .env.test -f compose.test.yaml up --exit-code-from cypress
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: NODE_VERSION=$(cat .nvmrc) CYPRESS_SPEC="cypress/e2e/smoke" docker compose --env-file .env.test -f compose.test.yaml up --exit-code-from cypress
scripts.test:e2e:regression: NODE_VERSION=$(cat .nvmrc) CYPRESS_SPEC="cypress/e2e/regression" docker compose --env-file .env.test -f compose.test.yaml up --exit-code-from cypress
scripts.test:e2e:custom: NODE_VERSION=$(cat .nvmrc) docker compose --env-file .env.test -f compose.test.yaml up --exit-code-from cypress
scripts.test:e2e:build: NODE_VERSION=$(cat .nvmrc) docker compose --env-file .env.test -f compose.test.yaml up --build --exit-code-from cypress
scripts.test:e2e:local: NODE_VERSION=$(cat .nvmrc) docker compose --env-file .env.test -f compose.test.yaml up -d frontend_test backend_test nginx-test postgres_test
scripts.cy:open: cd frontend && npx cypress open --config baseUrl=http://localhost:8080
scripts.test:ci:smoke: CYPRESS_SPEC="cypress/e2e/smoke" docker compose --env-file .env.test -f compose.test.ci.yaml up --exit-code-from cypress --abort-on-container-exit
scripts.test:ci:critical: CYPRESS_SPEC="cypress/e2e/critical" docker compose --env-file .env.test -f compose.test.ci.yaml up --exit-code-from cypress --abort-on-container-exit
scripts.rebuild:frontend_test: NODE_VERSION=$(cat .nvmrc) docker builder prune -a -f && docker compose -f compose.test.yaml build frontend_test --no-cache
scripts.rebuild:backend_test: NODE_VERSION=$(cat .nvmrc) docker builder prune -a -f && docker compose --env-file .env.test -f compose.test.yaml build backend_test --no-cache
scripts.test:e2e:up: npm run test:e2e:local && npm run cy:open
